title: Bioreactor BR-02 Temperature Spike During Fermentation
confirmed_root_cause: Cooling water jacket pneumatic valve solenoid stickiness caused delayed response to cooling loop command.
capa_action: Replaced solenoid valve SV-204 on BR-02 and added 6-month preventive maintenance lubrication cycle.

title: Temperature sensor RTD drift on BR-01 leading to false heater activation
confirmed_root_cause: Probe RTD-01A was overdue for 90-day NIST calibration by 14 days and had drifted -1.8°C low, causing the control loop to overheat the vessel.
capa_action: Recalibrated RTD-01A, initiated electronic calibration tracking log in CMMS, and quarantined affected lot.
